**I am a postdoctoral scholar in Psychology and Neuroscience at The Ohio State University** and a member of both the [Affective Science Lab](https://affectivesciencelab.com/) and the [Social Neuroscience and Health Lab](https://carolinasnhlab.com/). I study how people sense and make sense of their bodies with implications for human health and social functioning across the lifespan.
